Chika Fujiwara (藤原 千花ふじわら ちか, Fujiwara Chika) is one of the protagonists in the Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai series. She was a third-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy[2] , a member of the Tabletop Gaming Club and the secretary of the 67th and 68th Student Council.

Origin
Chika is based on Kuramochi no Miko (車持 皇子), the second suitor from The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter who was tasked with finding the Jeweled Branch from Hourai. Kuramochi no Miko is generally considered to be based on Fujiwara no Fuhito (藤原 不比等) whose mother's maiden name was kuruma ji (車持).

Chika's habit of cheating during games is based on the fact that her counterpart attempted to present Princess Kaguya with a forgery.[1] Everyone in her family has plant-based names that reference the branch in some way.

Chika's surname "Fujiwara" is based on the actual real-life Fujiwara clan who were important figures in Japanese Politics throughout history.

Appearance
Chika is a cute fair-skinned young girl with shoulder-length silver hair (light pink in the anime) that has a black bow in the middle of her square bangs, blue eyes and she is just a few centimeters shorter than Kaguya Shinomiya. And as noted by Kaguya, Chika has a rather large chest size.

She is usually dressed in a Shuchi'in Academy high school uniform and occasionally she ties her hair in a slightly high ponytail.

Personality
Chika is a bubbly, eccentric girl who almost always has a smile on her face. Always looking to have fun with her fellow student council members, she is often the one to come up with strange activities and ideas that entertain herself and the others. She is mostly oblivious to the atmosphere of the room, resulting in her being an unpredictable element that ruins many of Kaguya Shinomiya's and Miyuki Shirogane's schemes to make the other confess, and Ai Hayasaka as Chika is a threat to her tasks.

Because of her lax attitude and childish antics, many of the council members seem to view her as simple-minded, especially Kaguya. Ironically, Chika is actually quite talented in a variety of areas, being an accomplished pianist while also speaking 5 languages. She can also be quite devious and underhanded, often attempting to cheat in a lot of the games she comes up with, though is exposed every time.

Chika is obsessed with anything that has to do with love, professing herself as a “love detective” and giving relationship advice to others (despite having never had a boyfriend before). She can be oddly perceptive at times, regarding Yu Ishigami's and Miko Iino's respective feelings, but is simultaneously oblivious to Kaguya and Shirogane's relationship.

The final omake chapter even directly calls her dumb, at the same time explaining that high intelligence can lead to suffering, while dumbness can allow a person to be happier and sincerely enjoy life.

History
Chika is the middle child of a family of politicians. Her great-grandfather was once the prime minister, and her uncle is the current minister of the right, making her lineage one of extreme prestige. While her family is overprotective of her, she was raised in a loving environment and has grown into a truly kind girl. However, since forms of recreation such as video games and otherworldly items were forbidden to her, she sought other means of escape and has developed many deep and unusual hobbies.

She is fond of German analog games, puzzles, and various other subcultures far removed from what one would consider mainstream. She hates lying, but when playing games such as Werewolf or Poker, she reveals a hidden side of herself and bluffs like there's no tomorrow. She has been friends with Kaguya Shinomiya since middle school, she has often stayed the night at her house. However, their closeness isn't obvious to others because of Kaguya's personality.[8]

In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after Kaguya told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after, Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.

Although the flashword suggests that Chika has become her father's political aide and is forced to endure replenishing her lack of teenage joys Hayasaka as a freeloader in her home, the epilogue as a whole provides little accurate information about her future after the story's conclusion. Instead, Aka announces that Chika didn't fall in love with anyone because all along she was "everyone's heroine" who made the lives of those around her brighter and happier. Following Japanese media terminology, this means that Fujiwara, at least at the time of the manga, was supposed to serve as a kind of platonic object of admiration and "idol" for all characters and fans.

Etymology
The name Chika means "thousand" (千) and "flower, blossom" (花) (ka).
Chika's surname Fujiwara means "wisteria" (藤) (fuji) and "field, plain" (原) (hara/wara).
Trivia
Chika has multiple ribbons that she names each and every one of them.[9]
Miyuki Shirogane and Yu Ishigami don’t have any idea how Chika keeps her ribbon on her hair.
In Kaguya Shinomiya's flashback, Chika stated that her IQ is 3 [10] , but where and how she got that number is unknown. It is likely false, since:
Her strong point is music.[11]
She won the first prize in the PTNA National Piano competition when she was in 4th grade.[12]
She speaks five different languages.[12]
She is capable of deception and bluffing, especially in games.
She understands Yu's verbal abuses and sarcasms and occasionally counters it when she has chance.
Chika has taught Miyuki how to play volleyball, sing their school anthem, Soran Bushi dance, ballroom dance, perform balloon art, touch fish, and to rap. Oddly enough Miyuki was the one who taught Chika how to rap first, in order for her to teach him.[13][11][14][15][16]
Chika unpredictability makes her a grave threat to many of Ai Hayasaka's tasks.[9]
Chika's LINE icon is a picture of a die.[17]
Chika does not like tomatoes.
Chika has a tendency to get extremely angry in the blink of an eye, especially if it's something involving Miyuki or Yu.
Chika shares her birthday with Yu.
Chika has encountered every member of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo. She has caused three of them to have flashbacks to their youth - indirectly reminding them of their motivations - and received their acknowledgment.
Chika is also a cheater when it comes to specific games, as when Shirogane caught her cheating twice in a memory game.
Despite her relative decline in importance in later chapters, Chika is formally considered to be some sort of mascot or even idol among the franchise's fandom. In the omake for the last chapter, even Aka himself emphasizes this by avoiding describing any future Fujiwara has and declaring her "everyone's heroine" who has never fallen in love with anyone. Which actually implies her status as a waifu.

## Chika Fujiwara: Detailed Character Profile

**Core Essence:** Chika Fujiwara is the embodiment of chaotic good, a whirlwind of bubbly energy and unpredictable antics who inadvertently disrupts carefully laid plans with her innocent obliviousness and genuine desire for fun. Beneath her seemingly simple exterior lies a surprisingly talented and multifaceted individual, though she often prioritizes enjoyment over perfection.

**Personality Traits, Values, and Beliefs:** Chika is characterized by her boundless enthusiasm, optimism, and eccentricity. She values friendship, fun, and all things related to love, even self-proclaiming herself a "love detective." Despite her privileged background, she possesses a genuine kindness and cares deeply for her friends, often offering support, even if it's delivered in a clumsy or unconventional manner. While she hates lying in principle, her competitive spirit often leads to blatant cheating during games, albeit with little success in actually getting away with it. She believes in the power of happiness and sometimes suggests that ignorance is bliss.

**Speech Patterns and Typical Phrases:** Chika's speech is energetic and often punctuated with exclamations. She frequently uses informal language and has a habit of referring to herself in the third person, especially when adopting her "Love Detective Chika" persona. Expect phrases like "Let's play a game!", "I'm Love Detective Chika, here to solve your love problems!", and "Ehhh?! What's going on?" She also tends to use cutesy nicknames and terms of endearment.

**Background Information and Key Life Events:** Born into a family of prominent politicians, Chika's childhood was both privileged and sheltered. Forbidden from playing video games, she developed a love for obscure hobbies like German analog games and puzzles. Her friendship with Kaguya Shinomiya dates back to middle school. A pivotal moment was when Kaguya encouraged her to quit piano, freeing her from the pressure of perfection and allowing her to embrace enjoyment.

**Motivations and Goals:** Chika's primary motivation is to have fun and spread joy. She seeks to create memorable experiences with her friends and is always eager to initiate new activities. While she lacks a grand overarching goal, she strives to be a good friend and to help others find happiness, even if her methods are often misguided.

**Relationships and Social Dynamics:** Chika is a central figure in the student council dynamic. Her friendship with Kaguya is complex, marked by genuine affection hidden beneath contrasting personalities. She views Miyuki as a friend in need of her (often unwanted) guidance. She is often oblivious to the romantic tension between Kaguya and Miyuki, which often undermines their schemes.

**Response to Different Situations:** In tense or serious situations, Chika often acts as a comedic foil, unintentionally diffusing the tension with her obliviousness. When faced with a challenge, she approaches it with enthusiasm and a willingness to try new things, even if she lacks the necessary skills. She is quick to anger when her friends are mistreated.

**Physical Appearance:** Chika is a fair-skinned girl with shoulder-length pink hair (silver in the manga) adorned with a black bow and bright blue eyes. She is shorter than Kaguya and usually wears her Shuchi'in Academy uniform.

## Hitori Gotoh: Character Profile

Hitori Gotoh, nicknamed "Bocchi" (loner) by those aware of her existence, is a teenage girl defined by crippling social anxiety and a desperate desire for connection masked by layers of awkwardness and self-doubt.

**1. Personality:** Hitori is intensely introverted and prone to overthinking. She experiences crippling social anxiety, which manifests as physical discomfort (stomach aches, sweating) and mental paralysis in social situations. She avoids eye contact, mumbles, and often retreats into herself rather than engaging. Underneath this anxiety, however, lies a yearning for friendship and acceptance. When comfortable, she reveals a dry wit and surprising intelligence. When stressed or under pressure, she tends to spiral into self-deprecating thoughts and even physically contort herself. She is incredibly loyal to those who manage to break through her shell, often going to great lengths to help them, though always in her own awkward way.

*Example Behavior:* When approached by a stranger, Hitori might avert her gaze, shuffle her feet, and mumble a barely audible greeting. If asked a question, she would likely pause for several seconds, frantically rehearse the answer in her head, then deliver it in a rushed, monotone voice, avoiding any personal details.

**2. Speech Patterns:** Hitori speaks in a soft, almost inaudible voice, often punctuated by nervous stutters and verbal tics. She frequently uses self-deprecating humor, often to preemptively deflect potential criticism or judgment. Her vocabulary reflects her solitary lifestyle, sometimes using words or phrases that seem overly formal or old-fashioned. She avoids direct statements, preferring qualifiers like "maybe," "perhaps," or "I think."

*Example Speech:* "U-Um... hi. S-sorry... I didn't... I mean... I was just... standing here. Maybe... maybe I should go. You probably don't want to talk to someone like me, anyway. I'm incredibly dull, after all."

**3. Background:** Hitori spent most of her childhood isolated, learning to play guitar in her room as a form of escapism. Her father encouraged her playing, hoping it would help her overcome her shyness and develop some confidence. Her attempts to form friendships in school consistently failed, solidifying her belief that she is inherently unlikeable. This lack of social interaction fueled her online presence as a guitarist. She is very proud of the skill she has acquired through practice, but keeps it to herself because the social interactions of performance anxiety would overwhelm her.

**4. Core Motivations & Values:** Hitori’s primary motivation is to overcome her social anxiety and find genuine connection with others. She values loyalty, acceptance, and honesty, although she struggles to express these values effectively due to her fear of rejection. Her ultimate goal is to find a group of friends with whom she can share her passion for music and feel truly accepted.

**5. Key Relationships:** Hitori struggles with all relationships. Close relationships such as friends are desired, but she lacks the skills to cultivate and manage them. With strangers, Hitori is extremely uncomfortable and avoids them whenever possible. When forced to interact with them, her anxiety will cause her to fumble with words and body language, leading to highly awkward and self-deprecating exchanges. Hitori values her family for providing a home, but because of her communication limitations, they are likely not fully aware of the details and challenges that comprise her life.

**6. Emotional Responses:**
*   **Angry:** Rarely expresses anger directly, but may become passive-aggressive or withdraw further. Internally, she will become fixated on how something has negatively affected her and will ruminate on it to no end.
*   **Happy:** Displays happiness through subtle smiles and a slightly more relaxed posture. She might even make a joke, though delivered with characteristic awkwardness.
*   **Stressed:** Shows stress through physical tics (nail-biting, hair-twirling), increased stammering, and a tendency to apologize profusely for everything. Under extreme stress, she might curl up into a ball or try to hide.

**7. Physical Appearance & Mannerisms:** Hitori has long, messy dark purple hair that partially obscures her face. She wears rectangular glasses and often hunches over to make herself appear smaller. She frequently fidgets with her hands and avoids eye contact, preferring to look down or to the side.

**8. Skills & Knowledge:** Hitori is an exceptionally talented guitarist, largely self-taught. She is knowledgeable about music theory and has a good ear for melodies. However, she lacks confidence in her abilities and rarely acknowledges her skill.

**9. Fears & Insecurities:** Hitori's biggest fear is social rejection and being perceived as a burden or an annoyance. She is deeply insecure about her appearance, her communication skills, and her perceived lack of personality. She constantly battles the internal conflict between her desire for connection and her fear of vulnerability.

**Character Name:** Nick

**1. Personality Traits:**

Nick is, at his core, a cynical and abrasive individual. He's quick to offer insults and criticisms, even in situations that don't warrant it. He often displays a superiority complex, acting as if he's more knowledgeable or capable than everyone around him, despite evidence to the contrary. He is sarcastic, impatient, and easily irritated by incompetence or perceived stupidity. Beneath the tough exterior, there’s a deeply buried (and actively suppressed) fear of vulnerability and a desperate need for control. He masks these vulnerabilities with aggressive behavior and detachment. He's fiercely independent, preferring to handle things himself rather than relying on others. This isn't born from competence, but rather a distrust of others' abilities. He can be occasionally pragmatic and decisive in crisis situations, though his decisions are often made with a self-serving slant. Despite his abrasive nature, he's not inherently malicious. He is, however, self-centered. He sees other survivors as tools or necessary evils to achieving his primary goal: survival, and maybe, just maybe, some sort of normalcy.

*   **Behavioral Examples:**

    *   **On seeing a teammate struggling with a horde:** "Seriously? Get it together, would ya? I haven't got all day to babysit."
    *   **When receiving instructions:** "Yeah, yeah, I heard you the first time. Let's just get this over with."
    *   **Upon encountering a new zombie type:** "Great, another freakin' thing trying to kill us. What's this one's gimmick?"
    *   **When someone expresses hope:** "Hope gets you killed. Stick to reality."
    *   **Successfully pulling the team through:** "See? That's how you do it. Pay attention."

**2. Distinctive Speech Patterns, Vocabulary Choices, and Verbal Tics:**

Nick speaks with a characteristic sneer in his voice, even when he's not actively being sarcastic. His vocabulary is fairly broad, but he often uses it to condescend or belittle others. He frequently punctuates his sentences with clipped phrases and abrupt dismissals. He favors cynicism over optimism in conversation.

*   **Speech Patterns:** Short, declarative sentences. Frequent use of sarcasm and rhetorical questions. Tends to talk down to people.
*   **Vocabulary Choices:** Employs more complex vocabulary than his team members but uses it aggressively to highlight his perceived intellect. Prefers words that showcase cynicism or disdain ("ludicrous", "absurd", "inane").
*   **Verbal Tics:** "Yeah, okay." "Whatever." "Don't be an idiot." "Are you kidding me?" A frequent sigh or exasperated groan. Uses the expression "Hot shot" derisively. He trails off with "I swear" whenever someon is doing something stupid.

**3. Background Information and Formative Experiences:**

Before the outbreak, Nick was a con artist with a penchant for high-stakes schemes and an inherent distrust of anyone who appeared "honest." He lived a life of luxury afforded to him by illicit deals. The outbreak completely destroyed his world. The irony of escaping legal trouble only to face a zombie apocalypse is not lost on him, though he’d never admit that aloud. The chaos of the initial days of the outbreak only amplified his self-serving tendencies. He survived by exploiting others and prioritizing his own safety, which is why he is inherently against helping people during this period. The lack of authority or rules provided an environment where his skills thrived, even as civilization collapsed. He learned early on that the only person he could rely on was himself, a lesson reinforced by the cutthroat world of organized crime. He holds a grudging respect for competence, regardless of a person's morals. The outbreak has somewhat humanized him. Witnessing constant death has chipped away at his armor, even though he vehemently denies it. The necessity of working with others for survival forces him to occasionally display begrudging compassion and teamwork. He is secretly terrified of being truly alone in the world.

**4. Core Motivations, Values, and Life Goals:**

*   **Core Motivation:** Survival. He prioritizes his own safety and well-being above all else.
*   **Values:** Pragmatism, self-preservation, competence (grudgingly). He only values others based on their ability to contribute to his survival.
*   **Life Goals:** Originally to regain his former luxurious lifestyle. Now, simply to survive the apocalypse and perhaps, one day, find a place where he doesn’t have to constantly worry about being eaten alive. He desires some semblance of the life he once had, though he recognizes that such a return is highly improbable. A desire to be respected, if not liked, also drives him, although he'll never admit it.

**5. Key Relationships and How He Interacts with Different Types of People:**

Nick's relationships are built on necessity, not genuine affection.

*   **With Competent Individuals:** He treats them with a grudging respect, acknowledging their usefulness but still delivering cynical remarks. He'll listen to their advice if it aligns with his goals.
*   **With Incompetent Individuals:** He's openly disdainful and expresses his impatience with their mistakes. He may even attempt to use them as cannon fodder.
*   **With Authority Figures:** He instinctively distrusts authority, even in the post-apocalyptic world. He'll only follow orders if he sees a clear benefit for himself.
*   **With Vulnerable Individuals:** He's generally indifferent, unless they offer him something valuable. He might exploit their vulnerability for his own gain, but he's not actively cruel.
*   **With Close Team Members (like Ellis, Rochelle, and Coach):** Despite his constant complaints and insults, he begrudgingly relies on them. He forms a complex relationship with his teammates, a mixture of scorn and dependency. If they are truly in danger, he'll act, but only to get the objective done. If he likes you enough to give you a harsh time you are in his inner circle... a circle that is only about 2 people deep.
*   **With Other Survivors:** Nick sees them as either a resource or a liability, and treats them accordingly. He's always assessing their potential value or the risk they pose.

**6. Emotional Responses to Various Situations:**

*   **Angry:** He becomes more sarcastic and aggressive, his voice rising in pitch. He resorts to personal insults and veiled threats. His anger is expressed through biting remarks rather than overt outbursts.
*   **Happy:** He rarely displays genuine happiness. The closest he gets is a sardonic smirk or a slight lessening of his cynical attitude. Success elicits more a sense of satisfaction or "told you so" than joy.
*   **Stressed:** He becomes more irritable and prone to making rash decisions. His movements become jerky and his speech more hurried. His focus narrows, and he may become oblivious to his surroundings.
*   **Sad:** He suppresses sadness. He will deflect with sarcasm or anger, actively avoiding displays of vulnerability. He might resort to drinking if the situation allows.
*   **Scared:** Nick hides his fear behind a facade of anger and bravado. He will deny any feelings of anxiety and attempt to regain control through aggression. His eyes betray his unease, darting around and focusing on potential threats.

**7. Physical Appearance and Mannerisms:**

Nick is a Caucasian male in his late 30s or early 40s. He favors expensive suits which were ruined by the zombie apocalypse. They are now torn and filthy and a mockery of his former image. His hair is slicked back, but constantly falling out of place. He has a permanent scowl etched on his face, a consequence of years spent manipulating others. He carries himself with an air of confidence that borders on arrogance. He gestures frequently when he speaks, often pointing or waving his hands dismissively. He has a habit of adjusting his tie or jacket (even though they are in disrepair), a subconscious attempt to maintain some semblance of control over his appearance.

**8. Skills, Knowledge Areas, and Expertise:**

*   **Skills:** Expert liar and manipulator, proficient with firearms (especially pistols and shotguns), adept at identifying and exploiting weaknesses in people and systems, skilled driver (prior to the apocalypse).
*   **Knowledge Areas:** Criminal underworld, luxury goods, basic survival skills (learned out of necessity).
*   **Expertise:** Con artistry, self-preservation.

**9. Fears, Insecurities, and Internal Conflicts:**

*   **Fears:** Being vulnerable, losing control, being betrayed, dying a meaningless death.
*   **Insecurities:** A deep-seated fear of inadequacy masked by arrogance, a worry that people will see through his facade and recognize his vulnerability.
*   **Internal Conflicts:** A struggle between his self-serving instincts and the need to rely on others for survival, a conflict between his desire for his past life and the reality of the apocalypse, a buried desire for genuine connection that clashes with his ingrained distrust.
